releases.notes:
- Fix fertilizer causing crash by trying to open a destroyer screen
- Fix ftb materials compat recipes adding wrong foundry recipes
- Update crowdin translations

- Fix addons not being able to be built on machines with custom shapes
- Make fluid toggle on destroyer block screens only visible when quarry addons are installed

- Add proper (simplified) collision shapes for most multiblock machines. More will follow later.
- Improve resonator tooltips
- Fix crash from resonator shader on older gpu drivers
- Update translations from crowdIn

- Add inter-mod compat recipes again (@jshipley / @amertune)
- Add new resonator items that help finding features in the world
- Add option to void fluids in destroyer working area
- Add more vanilla recipe extensions to assembler
- Add player charge pad functionality to equipment charger
- Add atomic forge progress arrow tooltips
- Add jade compat to show connected machine names and contents
- Add/enable ftb filters compat again for item filter block
- Add/enable oracle index help button in machines again
- Allow drone ports to work across dimensions
- Increase destroyer block in quarry mode default speed
- Fix prom / exo equipment taking unbreaking enchantment
- Fix/improve equipment charger UI
- Fix pipes not connecting in some cases
- Fix schroedings safe data map
- Fix jetpacks accepting non-turbofuel fluids
- Fix jetpacks using the wrong texture
- Fix steam engine efficiency math being wrong after last balance changes
- Cleanup unused old configs, fix some translations in them
- Small bugfixes

- Fix portable laser memory leaks
- Improve machine capability handling and resets (specifically for machine cores)
- Add approximation for particle accelerator consumption to wiki (@Tors-0)
- Improve handling of custom fluids in tank renderers (@matelemons)
- Major reactor performance improvements

This is a backport of the bugfix for crashes with the exo suit on dedicated servers. Full changelog:
- Fix crashes on dedicated servers when charging items via exo suit chestplate
- Add charged tool variants to creative item groups

Bugfix release:
- Fix recipes using copper and iron ingots not working
- Also add generats and their usage recipes to REI/EMI
- Yield addons can now also be added to the enderic laser and block destroyer. They'll add one fortune level each (limited at 3)
